page_title: NAN 1-1 NIC | Nantes v Nice 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Johann Lepenant comes off the pitch to be replaced by Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes).
90+3' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Tom Louchet (Nice) replaces Ali Abdi.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
89' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
86' Wonderful movement by Nice. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
85' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.

82' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Marcin Bulka displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
82' Nantes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
82' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. It will be a corner kick for Nantes.
77' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tino Kadewere (Nantes) replacing Pedro Chirivella.
77' Substitution. Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) has come on for Matthis Abline.

72' 1 - 1 Evann Guessand (Nice) receives a sweet pass into the box that puts him in a one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He accepts this chance and rips a shot into the top left corner. Brilliant finish!

72' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nice are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
70' Pablo Rosario (Nice) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alban Lafont makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
69' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sofiane Diop (Nice) is coming onto the pitch as Youssoufa Moukoko cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Gaetan Laborde (Nice) for Jeremie Boga.
67' 1 - 0 Matthis Abline (Nantes) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the right post.
65' Antoine Kombouare decides to make a substitution. Florent Mollet will be replaced by Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes).
65' Substitution. Sorba Thomas (Nantes) on for Mostafa Mohamed.
63' Florent Mollet (Nantes) picks up an injury.
61' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
61' Jeremie Boga (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Nice earn a corner.
60' Florent Mollet (Nantes) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Marcin Bulka is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
58' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alban Lafont intercepts the ball.
56' Wonderful movement by Nice. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
53' Antoine Mendy (Nice) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
53' Good work from Nice as they win a corner.

52' A sweet pass finds Jeremie Boga (Nice) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Alban Lafont is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
51' The corner by Moses Simon (Nantes) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
51' The ball is cleared after Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Nantes can continue in their attacking effort.
51' Ali Abdi (Nice) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
49' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+1' Alban Lafont makes a brilliant save! Evann Guessand (Nice) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Nantes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
43' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is about to take a corner kick.
41' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
39' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) was quite harsh and Gael Angoula didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Ali Abdi (Nice) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
34' Nice are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
33' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Nathan Zeze (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
28' Jeremie Boga (Nice) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
26' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
24' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Gael Angoula signals.
21' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.

20' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice. Ali Abdi (Nice) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
20' A quickly taken corner by Nice.

20' Jeremie Boga (Nice) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Alban Lafont has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' Surely that's handball by one of the Nantes players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.

14' Matthis Abline (Nantes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Nantes will have a corner.
9' A pass by Evann Guessand (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
4' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) stoops for a header low near the left post from a cross, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save!

4' Nantes slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nantes will kick-off.
Gael Angoula will supervise the game today.
